Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing assessments for nuisance abatement in cities and towns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assessments for nuisance abatement in cities andtowns; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 35A.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city or town that exercises its authority under chapter 7.48RCW, RCW 35.22.280, 35.23.440, or 35.27.410, or other applicable law toabate a nuisance must provide prior notice to the property owner thatabatement is pending and a special assessment may be levied on theproperty for the expense of abatement. The notice must be sent byregular mail. (2) A city or town that exercises its authority under chapter 7.48RCW, RCW 35.22.280, 35.23.440, or 35.27.410, or other applicable law todeclare a nuisance, abate a nuisance, or impose fines or costs uponpersons who create, continue, or maintain a nuisance may levy a specialassessment on the land or premises where the nuisance is situated toreimburse the city or town for the expense of abatement. A city ortown must, before levying a special assessment, notify the property p. 1 EHB 1367owner and any identifiable mortgage holder that a special assessmentwill be levied on the property and the amount of the specialassessment. The notice must be sent by regular mail. (3) The special assessment authorized by this section constitutesa lien against the property and is of equal rank with state, county,and municipal taxes.

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city that exercises its authority under chapter 7.48 RCW orother applicable law to abate a nuisance must provide prior notice tothe property owner that abatement is pending and a special assessmentmay be levied on the property for the expense of abatement.
